_about: Everything the heart story shows. The heart itself in detail, as meshes: its four chambers (hollow walls, so a cut shows the cavities and how thick each wall is), every valve leaflet the atlas has, the papillary muscles the AV valves hang from, and the coronary arteries; and the great vessels where they join it, which are cut and beat with it. Every other blood vessel in the atlas -- every systemic artery and vein, the pulmonary vessels and the cardiac veins, about 650 of them -- comes as a centreline with a radius at each point, and the page builds the tubes: the meshes would be 3 million triangles. They meet end to end, so the page can search them for the routes blood takes round the body. Lungs, trachea and a heavily decimated skeleton are context, shown as ghosts. Later selectors override earlier ones, so the broad collections come first. Build: node tools/anatomy/zanatomy.js build human_anatomy/heart/heart.recipe.json, then pack it into the page with node tools/anatomy/zanatomy-pack.js human_anatomy/heart/heart.glb human_anatomy/heart/heart.html.

include.match: ^(Pulmonary trunk|Bifurcation of pulmonary trunk|Left pulmonary artery|Right pulmonary artery)$
^(Ascending aorta|Aortic arch|Superior vena cava|Inferior vena cava \(thoracic part\))$
